notes.title: Avium Update 37.0
notes.content:
[h2][b]Updates[/b][/h2]
Avium has a steep learning curve. The bosses and common enemies are challenging enough without the added factor of maintaining control of your War-Suit and its many tools of destruction. 
If you find the default control inputs unsuitable, you can customize the game's available inputs. If you wish to learn more about the default inputs, there are a few helpful menus at your disposal. 

The [b]'Controls' Tab[/b] in the Pause Menu lets you preview what each default input does for your main hero Diezel, while the other 4 playable characters in the game have their own Control Guides. The [b]'Controls' Window[/b] in the Main Menu gives you an overall default input map for Keyboard & Mouse, PlayStation, and Xbox controllers.


Other patches
[list]
[*] You can now quit out of races from the pause menu, letting you restart the race at will.
[*] Slide Mechanics Bug Fix. [b][i]Magic and Gun Combat are disabled during sliding.[/i][/b]
[*] Quick Select Mechanics Bug Fix [b][i]Much smoother swipes between windows, no duplicate windows.[/i][/b]
[*] Updated the Key Rebinding in the Main Menu. 
[*] Added an on/off toggle for the UI Help Bar that's persistent across most menus. [b][i]Can be toggled in the Display options from the Main Menu or in the in-game settings from the Pause Menu.[/i][/b]
[/list]
